used_archetypes: Secret Identity Crush: Academic rivals by day who don't realize they are anonymous late-night texting confidants
Brother's Best Friend Forbidden Crush: He treated her like a little sister for years until another guy asks her out and he gets jealous
7 AM Subway Strangers: Riding the same train car every morning in silence for a year until the train stops in a storm and he finally speaks
Time-Leap Second Chance: After losing her in a tragic future, he wakes up 4 years in the past on the day they first met and vows to protect her
The Second-Lead Umbrella Rescue: Her fiancé left her waiting in the rain, so his quiet older brother steps in with an umbrella and never leaves her side
Ruthless Young CEO & Fearless New Architect: Nobody dares to speak back to the company heir except her—and he becomes completely obsessed
Academic Rivals to Midnight Confidants: Fighting for #1 rank every semester while bickering daily, until he discovers her crying on the rooftop over family pressure and stays beside her every night

Childhood Friends to Soulmates: From age 9 sharing strawberries across next-door balconies, to age 16 defending her from bullies, to age 19 hiding jealousy when another boy confesses, to age 23 proposing under the same cherry tree

Intense Jealousy in Secret Love: The aloof student council president claims he only sees her as a junior, until a transfer boy makes her smile—shattering his calm mask as he pulls her into a golden sunset classroom to confess

Intense Jealousy in Secret Love: The cold student council president claims he only sees her as a junior, until a handsome transfer student makes her laugh—shattering his calm mask as he pulls her aside at sunset to confess

Contract Marriage to Real Obsession: Married on paper with a strict rule to never fall in love; when she prepares to leave thinking he loves someone else, he tears up the contract in the rain and begs her to stay
used_dialogues: Day one. Still quiet.
If you look, smile.
Morning. Same seat.
I save it, always.
One year. No words.
I memorized your silence.
The storm stopped us.
So you notice me?
I’ve loved you. Speak—
Then say it fully.
I can't believe this is real
He looks different yet familiar
I'll walk you home tonight
His eyes hold a promise
Stay close, I won't let go
My heart races with his protection
I love you beyond every timeline
I've waited for this moment forever
Together, we'll rewrite our destiny
With you, tomorrow feels safe
You shouldn't be alone out here.
He appears just as the rain intensifies.
I can hold this for you.
Your quiet presence feels comforting.
I'll never let the rain win.
My heart races as thunder roars.
I've always protected you from shadows.
I never expected love from a brother.
Will you walk with me, forever?
Yes, under any storm, together.
Who dares challenge my final design decision?
Your blueprint is structurally unsafe, sir.
Her defiance burns oddly warm inside my chest.
Why is my heartbeat this fast around him?
Stop that ridiculous trembling, you are shaking.
I am not trembling, stop controlling my body.
I have never lost to a rival like you.
Then admit you need my help, honestly.
I am officially obsessed with your fearless spirit.
I have never felt so completely seen.
Same train car. Every single morning.
If he looks over, I'll smile.
Here. Take my seat today.
He remembered my tired eyes...
Hold onto me. The lights went out.
His arms feel so safe...
I rode this train just for you.
For a whole year in silence?
I never want another silent morning.
Then walk with me every day.
You are only first by a point.
And you will be last, Ryu.
She is impossible to beat, truly.
I need this top ranking more.
Your family pressure is brutal, isn't it?
How did you know that, Ryu?
Stop crying, I will fail the exam.
They want me to marry a stranger!
Why is he wrapping his coat around me?
I will win the rank for you.
He has never shown kindness like this.
Every night, same rooftop, no excuses.
You are definitely obsessed with losing to me.
I stopped bickering because I love you.
My heart just completely stopped beating for a second.
Be my number one, not my rival.
Yes! I am yours forever, Ryu!
Stop crying! I saved you strawberries.
He always makes me smile...
Walk on the inside of the street.
Since when did he get so tall?
Why is that guy talking to her?
Wait, why are you pulling my sleeve?
Take my coat. Your hands are freezing.
His coat smells like winter rain...
Don't date anyone else! Look at me!
His heart is beating so loud...
I've loved you since we were kids.
I was scared to lose our friendship...
Every promise I made was for you.
He kept the ring from ten years ago!
From next-door neighbours to my wife?
Yes! A thousand times yes!
Forever starts right now with her.
My childhood friend is my whole life.
Here, catch this strawberry from above!
He always shares his best fruit with me...
Stop looking at her right now!
His voice is shaking with pure anger...
Why does his hand feel on her?
Maybe I should just go with him.
Come away from here immediately, today!
He looks so hurt and possessive suddenly...
I was jealous all along, okay?
He finally admitted his secret feelings to me...
I need some space to think, please.
Did I scare him off with my crying?
I just needed time to breathe, I love you.
He came back just to tell me this...
I can't wait for this special day.
Why are you smiling so mysteriously today, hyung?
Will you marry me under this tree?
Yes! I have loved you since forever!
Just a junior, nothing more.
Why does he always keep distance?
I must remain perfectly professional.
He looks so lonely up there.
Watch your step, transfer student.
Thanks for the warning, Senpai!
Her smile... only ever for me?
The transfer boy is so charming.
Hear me out. Right now.
What is wrong with you?
I hate seeing you smile at him.
His mask is finally cracking...
You are not just a junior.
Then who exactly am I to you?
You are the reason I exist.
I waited so long to hear that.
Let me keep you forever.
I am yours, always and only.
Just finish the report, junior.
His voice is so cold today.
Stop staring at him, you fool.
You're so funny, transfer student!
Stop him before he leaves!
Why is his heart pounding so fast?
Did you enjoy that joke?
I... I just felt happy.
I can't lose her to anyone.
Where are we going, Senpai?
Look at the horizon with me.
His eyes are soft right now.
I hate seeing you laugh at him.
Then tell me what to do.
Be mine, or I will burn it all.
He finally stopped pretending to be cold.
Remember our rule. No feelings allowed.
He barely even looks at me.
Just a business arrangement for now.
Signed. Let's keep our distance, hyung.
She's waiting for you downstairs.
Another girl? He never cares about me.
I have a meeting with her.
I understand. I will pack my bags.
Wait! Where do you think you're going?
Back to my own life, CEO.
Tears up the contract. I mean it.
He is finally admitting he wants me.
I fell in love. Don't leave me.
You only said that to stop me?
Stay. Be mine, not just my wife.
Okay... I'm not going anywhere.
Give me that, I'll hold it!
Hmm.. thank you.
Okay, shortie! Walk faster.
Stop calling me shortie!
What are you eating? Save me some?
Do you want a bite?
Hold onto my sleeve so you don't fall.
He is always so gentle with me...
Hey... are you crying?
Are you really leaving next month?
Wait for me until I return.
Wait! Don't dare forget me!
She has no idea how much I missed her.
You're finally back in my arms!
Hold still. Let me put it on for you.
He still treats me like a princess...
I love you. Forever starts today.
I love you too, my forever.
